Summoner

This is a build for mages who want to fight with their Chill Bill. It is especially usefull while fighting a dungeon with a fire setting (for example The Embercore Path).

Build

Put as many as possible of your points in Intellect, and the rest in Endurance.

Skills

These are the skills that you should use:

  Ice Bolt is used to do damage and heal your Chill Bill (left-mouse button)
  Ice Shards is another one to do damage and heal (right-mouse button)
  Build Snowman, this is the skill to call up Chill Bill (skill slot 1)
  Nippy Twigs is good to enhance your snowman (skill slot 2)
  Snow Globe is also good to enhance Chill Bill (skill slot 3)


These are all skills you definetly need. Now you can add skills you like. I recommend taking Bookworm, Couch Potato and Mental Prowess. As a member you should have the Bling Gnome in one of the remaining slots. Then 2 skill slots are still open. I fill them usually with Gym Freak (fighter) and Average BMI (ranger), to feel comfortable with my health. But of course, it is all up to you to decide. (See the article Gym Freak and Bookworm)

Gear

You can take whatever gear you like, as long as it gives you more Intellect and Endurance.

Strategy

This is very simple:

1) Summon your Chill Bill

2) Enhance him with all his buffs

3) Attack

4) Heal him with your ice spells when his health gets low
